verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's docs include an API reference section and an 'interactive Request Builder' that generates API requests in the user's chosen language, and an OpenAPI spec is published. That covers the interactive, example-generating part of the story, but nothing shows the reference itself lets users execute examples in place. missing for 10: evidence that API reference examples are runnable in-browser (try-it/playground execution), depth of the interactive reference beyond request generation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can use the interactive Request Builder to generate OpenRouter API requests in the language of your choice.
OpenRouter normalizes the schema across models and providers so you only need to learn one.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://openrouter.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
